sentence: This project studies how flood and stormwater infrastructure work together as a system during many different storms.
This project studies how food, predators and boat traffic affect where coastal dolphins go and how they behave.
This project builds methods that let a machine learn its own safety limits from weak feedback and act without taking unacceptable risks.
This project builds a quantum tool that speeds up simulations of fast changes in electric power grids.
This project studies how genetic variation in a human gene changes cellular outcomes.
This project tests network methods that use patents, publications and grants to find researchers working in quantum information science.
This project builds a framework for understanding and reducing the security risks of devices that connect computers with the human brain.
This project studies how advanced sensing, machine learning and robotic monitoring can help aquaponics systems use water, energy and nutrients more efficiently.
This project studies a family of magnetic compounds to find out whether they can be used to build a qubit.
This project studies the effect of adversarial thinking in introductory computing courses.
This project builds a probabilistic programming framework for hybrid system models and verifies the transformations of those models.
This project develops betting-based statistical methods for hypothesis testing, estimation and detecting changes in data that arrive continuously.
This project builds a system that uses images and deep learning to detect floods and give early warning to unsheltered people.
This project develops algorithms to analyze mechanical systems with imperfect or uncertain geometries.
This project builds imaging and modeling tools to find defects in semiconductor packages and predict which defects lead to device failure.
This project builds measurement tools to track changes in neuropeptides in cells stressed by copper toxicity and oxygen deprivation.
This project holds a conference that looks at how to encourage the secure development of open-source software.
This project makes organic radicals that emit light and studies how they emit it.
This project studies how two metal-binding proteins in the nematode worm respond to heavy metals and what they do in cells.
This project builds lipid nanoparticles that deliver mRNA and plasmid DNA into macrophages so they can kill solid tumors.
